# c3mv issue comparison

## Scope and methodology

- Corpus: `C:\bench\inputs\issues`; snapshot at 2026-11-13T00:15:14.544678+00:00.
- Scanned **143,470** SMT2 files recursively; selected **129,812**.
- Selection inspects declarations, binder sorts, and formula expressions for built-in String, Seq, RegEx/RegLan sorts, registered str./seq./re. operators, or string literals. Comments, set-info/set-option/set-logic, echo text, and named annotations are not matches.
- Input bytes were snapshotted and SHA-256 checked. Every selected file was run once on each branch; no content deduplication or sampling.
- This compares the complete pinned branch tips, including their different baseline histories; it does not isolate the effect of individual c3mv changes.
- Timeout: **5 seconds per entire file**, not per check-sat. Native `-T:5` plus an external 5-second wall-clock watchdog including process startup. Scheduling and termination can make observed wall time exceed the budget; maximum observed durations are reported below.
- Command: `z3.exe -in -smt2 -st -T:5`. Diagnostic echo delimiters were inserted before check-sat commands to align incremental query results; formulas and existing commands were unchanged.
- Up to **32 solver processes** concurrently. Each pair runs sequentially, with master-first and c3mv-first order alternated by corpus index. Both binaries use MSVC, CMake/Ninja Release builds.
- Timing includes startup, parsing, all queries, and requested output. Parallel-load timing is noisy; single-run ratios are descriptive, not a statistically established regression.
- A read-only input-selection audit overlapped the early measurement period. Timing therefore includes that background I/O as well as concurrent solver and audit-log activity.
- File outcome is the last query verdict on clean completion. Timeout overrides partial verdicts. Parser/command failures, crashes, and inputs producing no verdict are reported separately, not as unknown.
- Incremental verdict sequences are preserved below; `sat*3` means three consecutive sat verdicts. A timeout prefix does not imply that later queries completed.
- Host: Windows-11-10.0.26300-SP0; 32 logical processors.

| Branch | Tested commit | Binary SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| master | `bb5c03081d04da49007f19208596fd820d4f4cab` | `4b28ffcd2e329793d06b4c096905ad0108bd2c5c225553b58391d27cbb8f3b77` |
| c3mv | `3d5051cff627e044f5c217ac9f7e7cd5d9010a1c` | `98aa2906a909195ce56319e9ba94bad0cc76764a1e81030a6adedcc04ee9219d` |

## Outcomes and performance

| Metric | master | c3mv |
|---|---:|---:|
| sat | 68021 | 71146 |
| unsat | 46745 | 47354 |
| unknown | 2231 | 1215 |
| timeout | 11675 | 8928 |
| error | 1103 | 1132 |
| crash | 0 | 0 |
| no-verdict | 37 | 37 |
| Clean files with only sat/unsat verdicts | 114761 | 118496 |
| Total measured wall time (s) | 86878.077 | 60869.831 |
| Maximum observed process wall time including termination (s) | 5.883148 | 5.572868 |
| PAR-2 (s; unsolved/error/no-verdict charged 10 s) | 177985.831 | 128014.943 |
| Median clean solved file time (s) | 0.088387 | 0.086829 |

- Common clean-solved files with identical full verdict sequences: **112089**.
- Clean-solved only by master: **2672**; only by c3mv: **6407**.
- Geometric mean speedup (master time / c3mv time): **1.229x**; >1 favors c3mv.
- Identical file outcomes and full observed verdict sequences: **117950 / 129812**.
- Files with a corresponding-query SAT/UNSAT conflict: **0**.
- No corresponding-query SAT/UNSAT conflicts were found, so no conflict reruns were needed.
